quizGuardRationale: Author judgments for independent assessment: direct ordinary-meaning/actual-label overlap, symmetric and nontransitive. No baseline declaration changed. Exact spoon titles already deduplicate.
先程 guards short-while-ago and broad recent/earlier labels on さっき/先/こないだ/最近 without making them identical durations. 索引 does not automatically guard every contents/reference card.
裂く guards direct tearing/cutting/dividing/separating meanings on 破る/割る/切る/離す/分ける. 割く-only allocation is not silently a 裂く meaning or a reason to form an allocation clique.
削除 guards 消す/除く/外す/取る, including 取る's actual remove sense 1326980:5. Event discontinuation on 中止 is not automatic deletion.

作成/作製 form a direct pair; each separately guards broad 作る/こしらえる. 作成 independently guards preparation labels 準備/用意/支度. 作製 separately guards manufacture/production on 製造/生産; 工業 explicitly names manufacturing industry, not every individual making action.

探る guards searching/inquiry/examination on 探す/捜す/調べる/調査/研究/検査/検討/求める; 求める's actual seek/find-solution sense 1229350:3 matters beyond want/request. Not every common research topic is itself investigation.
ささやく guards ひそひそ/話す/言う speech and 噂/流す rumor circulation, including 流す1552120:5; crowd rustling/commotion ざわざわ is not automatically quiet speech.
刺さる guards sharp-piercing perspective on 刺す, sticking on 付く/くっつく, and ordinary emotional impact on 動く/感動/感心, including 動く1451210:4 despite its physical introductory card. Impact need not be positive.

座敷 guards 部屋 and especially-guest-room 客間, not an automatic room-use clique with 居間. 差し支え guards じゃま/障害/問題, including 問題1536010:5 inconvenience; generic circumstances 都合 is not inherently a hindrance.
差し引き guards 引く subtraction/ebb senses and 残り's actual balance sense 1304480:1, not every flow/current word or break-even とんとん. 刺身 guards broad fish 魚, not automatically the adjective 生 raw.

刺す guards insertion on 挿す, needlework on 裁縫/針 (1366210:6), insect biting 噛む and prick/sting label ちくちく. Its 差す pair is directly supported by boat-poling sense 1291330:11; no existing 突く card was found to reference.

挿す separately guards broad insertion 入れる, planting 植える, fastening/closing 付ける/閉じる/閉める/締める, and broad unqualified wear title 着る under sword-wearing recognition, without claiming that 着る itself takes swords. 差す's insertion/sword senses directly support that pair, not pronunciation alone.

注す guards direct pouring/addition on 注ぐ/酌む/汲む/浴びせる/流す/加える/足す/付ける/入れる, including 汲む1229610:2 actual pour-into-cup.
